# langsmith_prompt_repo_tags (Data Source)

Lists the named version tags on a LangSmith prompt repo. Tags such as `production` or `staging` point to specific commits.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_prompt_repo_tags" "example" {
  repo_handle = "my-prompt"
}

output "tag_names" {
  value = [for t in data.langsmith_prompt_repo_tags.example.tags : t.tag_name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_handle` (String) The handle of the prompt repo whose tags are listed.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags defined on the prompt repo. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `commit_hash` (String) The hash of the commit the tag points to.
- `commit_id` (String) The ID of the commit the tag points to.
- `created_at` (String) When the tag was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the tag.
- `repo_id` (String) The ID of the prompt repo the tag belongs to.
- `tag_name` (String) The name of the tag (e.g., `production`, `staging`).
- `updated_at` (String) When the tag was last updated.
